bio.text: Robert Short is the Republican candidate for Wyoming Secretary of State in 2026.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Short says he lives south of Douglas and has lived most of his life in Wyoming.
He says he was elected Converse County Commissioner in 2014 and re-elected twice.
He also says he worked in technology and then had a 20-year career in nuclear science, and that he started businesses in Douglas and Glenrock in 2004.
